basic_info.description:
Beautiful charming house on Sloat Blvd. 2 bedrooms - 1.5 bathrooms . Large living room with decorative fireplace, dining room, big kitchen with a built-in table that seats 6. Lots of old charm like built-in ironing board, dishwasher, lot's of cabinets. Up a few stairs to the bedrooms and bathrooms. Brand new carpet upstairs. Nice size bedrooms. Half bathroom is off one bedroom. Full bathroom is off hallway. Great natural light from windows. 
Two car garage. Low maintenance yard. Great location to west portal avenue shopping and Sonestown which has a lot to offer. Stern Grove across the street - free concerts in the summer and camps and a great place to walk around. easy access to muni transportation and freeways. Beautifully maintained home. Owner will mange the property.

Owner will pay for the gardener. No smoker - No pets - Owner manages the property. Tenants pay all utilities.
